name: Order’s Resilience

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Standing up from Prone costs you only 5 feet. While you and an ally within 5 feet of you aren't Incapacitated, both of you have Advantage on Strength saves.
